description: Summarize a large batch of IPs into distributions by country, continent, ASN/operator and network prefix, each bucket with a sample of addresses. Use instead of ip_lookup once the input is in the hundreds or thousands — ip_lookup returns every row, which no context window holds. Up to 5000 addresses or 100 hostnames. Counts are per occurrence; nothing is dropped silently (failed → `errors`, no database record → `no_data`, unlisted buckets → `tail`), the same input set always returns the same numbers, and the result is facts only — no datacenter/residential classification, no verdict. DB-IP Lite (CC BY 4.0).

anyOf.description: Whitespace- or comma-separated (paste a log column).

name: ip_summary
title: Summarize a batch of IPs (country / continent / ASN / network)
